issues.description: Stale comments still reference < 3.10 compatibility after the compat code was deleted
issues.detail: In chia/wallet/wallet_request_types.py the comment block 'field(default_factory=default_raise) (this is for < 3.10 compatibility)' and the default_raise docstring 'just for < 3.10 compatibility' remain after kw_only_dataclass was removed. Lying comments rot faster than code. Delete them in this same patch.

issues.description: install.sh still gates on PYTHON_MINOR_VER < 7 instead of < 10 after raising the floor
issues.detail: The error message was updated to say '>= 3.10' but the actual guard remains `[ "$PYTHON_MINOR_VER" -lt "7" ]`. So 3.7, 3.8, 3.9 will pass the check and then fail later in confusing ways. If you bump the minimum, bump the check. The message and the code must agree.

issues.description: THREE-PATCHES: CI cleanup, dataclass kw_only consolidation, and itertools.pairwise are unrelated
issues.detail: Dropping 3.9 from CI/install is one patch. Removing sys.version_info branches around kw_only is another. Switching zip(x, x[1:]) to itertools.pairwise is a third drive-by. Bisect will hate you when one of these regresses. Split them so reverts are surgical.

issues.description: dnf search lines added to install-scripts do nothing but spam logs
issues.detail: In test-install-scripts.yml the Amazon and Rocky prep blocks now run `dnf search python3.12` between update and install. search is interactive-discovery noise, not a build step; it does not gate or select anything. Either drop it or replace with an explicit version-pin install. Don't leave debugging scaffolding in CI.

issues.description: PR description contradicts itself on Union/Optional ruff enforcement
issues.detail: The description says 'Union types are no longer / will soon not be supported through Ruff' then strikes through 'are no longer'. Either the rule is on in this PR or it isn't. The diff does not appear to flip the ruff config. Land the policy change with the rule, or don't claim it. Ambiguity in the commit message is hostile to the next maintainer.

issues.description: Dead `default_raise` helper kept solely 'for < 3.10 compatibility' should go
issues.detail: default_raise() exists explicitly to work around 3.9's lack of kw_only. With 3.9 gone and every consumer now using `@dataclass(frozen=True, kw_only=True)`, fields like `wallet_id: uint32 = field(default_factory=default_raise)` are gratuitous: declare them as required positional-after-kw_only fields with no default. Removes a footgun and a coverage exclusion.

review.summary: The intent is right and overdue: drop 3.9, collapse the sys.version_info branches, simplify the dataclass call sites. The mechanical edits are mostly clean. But the patch is three patches pretending to be one, leaves stale '< 3.10 compatibility' comments and the `default_raise` workaround in place, and the install.sh version guard still uses the old 3.7 floor while the error message advertises 3.10. CI gained `dnf search` noise that does nothing. NEEDS-WORK: split the commits, finish the cleanup you started, fix the install.sh guard, drop the dnf search lines.
